summary: The authors emphasize that results vary when compared to highly optimised baseline code and that the community is debating whether the complexity of a new layout is justified. They converged on a LIST-based vector with constraints on fixed dimension, non-null finite numeric elements, and opened a PR to formalize it. The WIRE proposal introduces a new Parquet logical type that preserves raw protobuf/thrift messages while shredding selected fields into columnar columns for efficient querying. Andrew reviews the FSST proposal, suggesting the inclusion of an optional inline symbol table and the removal of the dedicated SYMBOL_TABLE_PAGE type.
